parts.latex:
It is given that $A = \dfrac{h}{2}(a + b)$ and $h = 7$, $a = 9$ and $b = 11$.

What is the value of $A$?

solutions.latex:
Substitute into the given formula.
$$\begin{aligned} A &= \dfrac{7}{2}(9 + 11) \\ &= 70 \end{aligned}$$
Hence the answer is A.

parts.latex:
The kinetic energy, $K$ (j) of a particle of mass $M$ (kg), with a velocity of $V$ (m/s) is given by:

$$K=\dfrac{1}{2}MV^2$$

Calculate the value of $K$, if $M=30$ kg and $V=22$ m/s

solutions.latex:
Substitute $M=30$ and $V=22$ into the formula.
$$\begin{aligned} K &= \dfrac{1}{2}\times 30\times 22^2 \\ &= 15\times 484 \\ &= 7260 \text{ j} \end{aligned}$$
So the answer is option B.

parts.latex:
The formula $C = \dfrac{5}{9}(F - 32)$ is used to convert temperatures between degrees Fahrenheit ($F$) and degrees Celsius ($C$).

Convert $7^\circ C$ to the equivalent temperature in Fahrenheit.
can_use: Changing the subject of a formula

solutions.latex:
Substitute $C = 7$ into the formula.
$$7 = \dfrac{5}{9}(F-32)$$
Multiply both sides by $\dfrac{9}{5}$.
$$\begin{aligned} F - 32 &= 7 \times \dfrac{9}{5} \\ &= 12.6 \\ F &= 12.6 + 32 \\ &= 44.6 \end{aligned}$$
$$\therefore\ 7^\circ\text{C} = 44.6^\circ\text{F}$$
criteria: Substitutes $C=7$ and finds $F-32 = 12.6$, or equivalent merit
Substitutes $C=7$ into the formula, or equivalent merit
